content.short: DFX is a Swiss service for buying and selling Bitcoin and 80+ cryptocurrencies directly to your wallet.
content.description: DFX is a Swiss crypto service for buying and selling Bitcoin, Ethereum and more than eighty other assets directly to and from a user's own wallet, without holding customer funds. Stable's official documentation lists it among the fiat ramps for the network. Non-custodial ramps like this leave the user in control of their assets throughout.
content.meta: DFX is a Swiss non-custodial service for buying and selling 80+ cryptocurrencies, listed as a Stable ramp.
